notes.title: Updates
notes.notes:
1) Dear users, a new paid service has appeared in the game - named personal artifacts. These are personal items of equipment that can be purchased, upgrade for platinum. Equipment items provide additional parameters that you can change yourself. The improvement is expressed in terms of a ratio relative to basic items. Maximum amplification factor = 2.0 (for items from monsters, the maximum is 1.0)

2) During the day, there will be an update to the game client with a built-in automatic drinking of potions of effects. You can use this service officially without punishment to make it easier to play in battle. Also, the client has a built-in system for automatic walking in three cells, attacking certain monsters and collecting certain things from them.

3) Shivas Potion is now available for palladium. Six-armed Shiva allows you to deal up to 6 hits in 1 measure, or use up to 6 spells (including dispel). The cost of the potion is 3 pd.

4) An item called "Useless Shit Invented By Admins", which was at one of the old events, was renamed to "Useful Shit Invented By Admins" and, when used, summons a pet "Shit Demon" with the parameters of the Genie from the Savanna, which will fight for you and walk after you for 60 minutes.

5) Players who bought more than 10,000 pt from dealers during the last year received administrator status and can no longer be killed. They are also given the ability to teleport around the map with a double click and the ability to summon other players. The update will be available after updating the game client during the day.

notes.title: Big Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35110153/b79d571cb2fd5fd3feff055d6c2e5f425ddd51f1.jpg[/img]

The world of DarkSwords will never be the same again. After the invasion of the hordes of Dagfar warriors, we had to retreat. The ancient Druids were able to open their own portal called the Thunder Gate and the inhabitants of the world rushed there. Not everyone managed to escape, but we, the survivors, went to another world, so similar to ours.
[list]
[*] Three starting kingdoms have been removed. Instead of them, one kingdom has appeared, which combines all three in spirit, with the main city of New Arkijah.
[*] The 4 regions around New Arkijah are as safe as the city. Access to some regions is closed at a minimum level.
[*] To the west of the new kingdom is the Moon Empire, except for the Reign of Hades, Tartarus, and the Styx Bank.
[*] In the east is the Undeads Village, Copper Rocks, the Millenia Realm (complete) and the Black Realm, which lost the Cursed Castle.
[*] In the south, there is a new kingdom "Mythical World" with the Antica Town, five new regions, a remade region where the Centaurs live, as well as the already familiar regions of Atlantis, the Altar of Ares, Reign of Hades, Tartarus and the Styx Bank. The Antica Town is a peaceful city surrounded by chaos regions with wide exit roads from the city.
[*] The islands are still closed. Boatl traffic will be partially restored later.
[*] Private shops cannot be placed in peaceful regions around New Arkijah, but in the city itself they can be placed in 9 squares called the Market. The rules are the same - no more than 3 stores per location. You can occupy location on a first come, first serve basis - in the order of messages from dealers to the administration. For details, ask with the dealers in the game.
[*] Some recipes cannot be crafted due to lack of ingredients. They will be changed later.
[*] With six cities remaining, Kingdom Battles are now taking place every day except Monday.
[*] Element List in the map window is disabled and will appear in the next version of the client.
[/list]

[*] [b]Potion of Solitude[/b] -  when used in combat, instantly turns on the solo mode. Cannot be used by dwarves in quest zones (including Antique China) - 4 pd (new)
[*] [b]Cloaking Device[/b] - the character under the effect of the potion is not visible on the mirrors. Time 60 min. - 3 pd(new)
[*] [b]Isolation Sphere[/b] - the user cannot be seen by other players compasses while under this effect, but the character cannot teleport. can be removed if you switch between clones on a star. Time 60 min. - 3 pd (new)
[/list]

notes.title: Currency reform. Stage #1
notes.notes: From August 1, the following changes are introduced:[list][*] Dwarves can no longer enter tournaments and do not receive Tournament Points[*] Tournaments will now depend not on combat levels, but on religious levels. Elixir of choice # 1 and # 2 will also be added to the assortment[*] For the quests "Serving the Cult" 5 Rubies will be given instead of Faith Currency[*] Capturing or holding territories will award 25 and 50 Rubies instead of 1 and 2 Conquest Currency[*] The store for Conquests is being removed. Currency will be converted to Rubies at the rate of 1:25[*]The store for Faith is being removed.  Currency will be converted to Rubies at the rate of 1:5[/list]

notes.title: Valentines Day
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35110153/f700654dc220311d84b93ea5e22640c30f7da7f2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Favorite Gift Bonus[/h2]

From February 11 to February 16 you will receive a 25% bonus when buying platinum from dealers. Indulge yourself and your soulmate.


[h2]Wedding season[/h2]


Prices for all weddings ordered from 11 to 16 of February have been reduced! Golden Wedding is now just 50 pt, and the platinum wedding is only 120 pt. 
Same prices apply for Combat Alliances.


[h2]Power of love[/h2]


All characters that are married will deal [b]double damage to monsters[/b] from 11 to 16 February.



[h2]The joint venture[/h2]


From 11 to February 16 you can buy Family Private shop with great discount [b]-500pt[/b]. Ask dealers in game for more details.


[h2]Holiday Quest[/h2]

From 11 to 16 of February you will see a Cupid in Arkijah that will need your help!


[b][i]Part one "Power of Love"[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35110153/7889aadfe97322e4a8c4c16e369eedcf21560664.jpg[/img] In this quest you will need to put together a Valentine. By killing monsters that have a higher level than you do (minimum 100 level of monsters), you have a chance to receive one of nine parts of a Valentine. After collecting all 9 pieces, place the central piece on the “table” in Laboratory and make the Valentine that you can then give to your loved one (by selecting a character and using the item). When used, Valentine will appear in the gift section within an hour and will stay there for 15 days. Additionally, a message will appear in chat that a Valentine was given. In return for a Valentine you will receive an item “Mutual Love”, that you will have to give to Cupid.



[b][i]Part two: "Three elements"[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35110153/3c16e15caf4e3935923f45dc2e23b36f8356c263.jpg[/img] Your love towards each other has to be proven. What’s the best way to show your love? That’s right, by trials. After finishing the first part, Cupid will offer you three quests: “Fire”, “Water” and “Copper Cliffs”. To accept the each part you should got Mutual Love again. Take these quests and make sure you follow the game chat. Collect all three spheres and give them to Cupid. For each quest you will receive a Ticket Part. After having all three pieces, place one of them on the Laboratory table and you will receive a “Ticket to Chocolate King’s Caste”



[b][i]Part three: "Chocolate King's Castle"[/i][/b](repeats once a day)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35110153/e70329510c3df1763b2c963f48e231fa7701ff7a.jpg[/img] Chocolate King is in panic – vile Trolls stole all his candy, and his daughters (that love candy very much) are angry at their father. In this quest, you will have to gather and return to the king the lost chocolates. The reward will be [b]Red Prism x2[/b] and [b]Sweet Gift[/b] a chest with bonuses for choose.






[h2] Show everyone what you will do for your loved ones! [/h2]
